        <payload><![CDATA[<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="ecc_agent_script_file"><ecc_agent_script_file action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><checksum>TBpM47XLmE8FfG/TQ//yOw==</checksum><description>Retrieves group details from Active Directory</description><directory>false</directory><name>ActionLookupGroup_AD_v2.ps1</name><parent display_value="ADv2Spoke">8ed69ce81b8d2010dd8e0e16ec4bcb48</parent><script> Import-Module ActiveDirectory -WarningAction SilentlyContinue


if (test-path env:\SNC_groupName) {
    $groupname = $env:SNC_groupName;
}

If(-Not $groupname){
    $result = "Group Name field is empty"
    $status = "Error"  
} 
Else{
    $groupname = $groupname -replace "%27", "'";
 
    try {
         $groupcategory = @{
            n = "GroupCategory"
            e = {
                    If($_.GroupCategory -eq 1) {
                        return "Security"
                    }
                    ElseIf($_.GroupCategory -eq 0) {
                        return "Distribution"
                    }
            }
        }
        $groupscope = @{
            n = "GroupScope"
            e = {
                    If($_.GroupScope -eq 0){
                        return "Domain Local"
                    }
                    ElseIf($_.GroupScope -eq 1) {
                        return "Global"
                    }
                    ELseIf($_.GroupScope -eq 2){
                        return "Universal"
                    }
            }
        }
        $grouptype = @{
            n = "GroupType"
            e = {
                    If($_.GroupType -eq 2) {
                            return "Global Distribution Group"
                    }
                    ElseIf($_.GroupType -eq 4) {
                            return "Domain Local Distribution Group"
                    }
                    ElseIf($_.GroupType -eq 8) {
                            return "Universal Distribution Group"
                    }
                    ElseIf($_.GroupType -eq -2147483646) {
                            return "Global Security Group"
                    }
                    ElseIf($_.GroupType -eq -2147483644) {
                            return "Domain Local Security Group"
                    }
                    ElseIf($_.GroupType -eq -2147483640) {
                            return "Universal Security Group"
                    }
            }
        } 
        $groupdetails = Get-ADGroup -Identity $groupname -Credential $cred -Server $computer -Properties * | Select-Object Name, DistinguishedName, DisplayName, ObjectGUID, SAMAccountName, CanonicalName, ManagedBy, $GroupScope, $GroupCategory, $GroupType, Description, @{n='OU';e={(($_.distinguishedName.Split(",",2)[1]))}}, MemberOf, Members
        $result = $groupdetails
        $status = "Success"
    }
    catch {
        $result = $_.Exception.Message
        $status = "Error"
    }
}

$response = @{
    status = $status
    body   = $result
} | convertTo-Json

Write-Output $response</script><script_attachment/><source/><sys_class_name>ecc_agent_script_file</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2022-09-11 10:39:54</sys_created_on><sys_customer_update>false</sys_customer_update><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>b7a019fa87b111107701ed3e0ebb35af</sys_id><sys_mod_count>5</sys_mod_count><sys_name>ActionLookupGroup_AD_v2.ps1</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Microsoft Active Directory v2 Spoke" source="sn_ms_ad_v2_spoke">bcfbc4241b4d2010dd8e0e16ec4bcba5</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_replace_on_upgrade>false</sys_replace_on_upgrade><sys_scope display_value="Microsoft Active Directory v2 Spoke">bcfbc4241b4d2010dd8e0e16ec4bcba5</sys_scope><sys_update_name>ecc_agent_script_file_b7a019fa87b111107701ed3e0ebb35af</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>system</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2023-07-27 20:53:05</sys_updated_on><u_fx_inactive>false</u_fx_inactive><u_source/><u_target/><use_attachment>false</use_attachment><version/></ecc_agent_script_file></record_update>]]></payload>
